Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different historical figures named “Julia Caesaris.” Julia, the daughter of Julius Caesar and Cornelia, married Pompey the Great; Marcus Atius Balbus was married to Julia (Caesar’s sister), not Cornelia’s daughter. Introducing Marcus Atius Balbus as an alternative spouse for Cornelia’s daughter led to an incorrect potential child-in-law and unnecessary confusion.
